title: Word frequency report
description: Count how often each word occurs in a text. The words are the space-separated words of the text; empty pieces from extra spaces are not words. Words are compared ignoring case, and every word is reported in upper case. The report lists "WORD=COUNT" for each distinct word, in the order of the first appearance of the word in the text, joined with a comma and a space. A text without words gives the empty text.
notes: The order is first appearance, not alphabetical and not by count. Case folding merges 'The' and 'the'. Natural for a Map in Zehn but the signature stays Text.
